messages:
deploy-bot: Deployment completed: release 2026.03.21-56 -> prod-usw2. Starting post-deploy smoke suite (synth-run id=sr-20260321-56, target=50rps).

sre-oncall: seeing an uptick in synth 429s from the new run, p95 latency looks fine but 429s ~3% on embed route :eyes:. No user alerts yet.

alex: which probe is hitting embeds? is it the short prompt sampler or the bulk coverage sampler?

michelle: quick grep: sr-20260321-56 -> probes: short-prompt-embed (concurrency=5) + burst-scan (concurrency=45). logs show RateLimitExceeded from edge: 

```
ERROR 2026-03-21T15:04:12Z embed.handler 429 \"Rate limit exceeded\" x-rate-limit-remaining=0 x-rate-limit-reset=13
```

michelle: header shows `x-synth: true`, so synthetic traffic is correctly tagged.

dina: probably the burst-scan is too aggressive against the new variant of the embed model. We should either throttle synth or temporarily lower burst concurrency. Prefer throttle for minimum blast radius.

jordan: agree with Dina. No real-user impact yet. I'd avoid rollback unless we see error propagation to user traffic. Can we reduce synth-run target to 10rps for 10m and re-evaluate?

sre-oncall: oncall -> I'll throttle the synth control plane. Command: `/synthctl update sr-20260321-56 --target-rps 10 --duration 10m`

deploy-bot: synth-run updated: sr-20260321-56 target=10rps (was 50rps). Notifying observability.

observability-bot: Alert suppressed for sr-20260321-56 (auto-throttle). Continuing to monitor embed.p95 and 5xx.

michelle: re-run quick health probe against user path (non-synth): `curl -sS -D - https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACT\" -d '{\"input\":\"test\"}'` -> 200 OK, latency 120ms, headers: `x-rate-limit-remaining: 89`.

alex: good. Can someone check token-bucket metrics for embed-route? I want to confirm it's the synth exhausting the shared bucket rather than a misconfigured rate-limit key.

dina: checking token-bucket dashboard -> embed-route shared bucket shows short spike correlated with sr-20260321-56 start. Token refill steady; synth burst consumed burst allowance.

jordan: action items: 1) keep synth throttled for 10m, 2) add guard on burst-scan to respect per-route soft cap (proposal: max-burst-concurrency=20), 3) postmortem if user-facing errors occur.

sre-oncall: I'll stay on the thread and watch for user-impact for the next 30m. No rollback planned. If 5xx > 0.5% or user latency p95 > 300ms, escalate to rollback or canary pin.

michelle: I'll file a quick RFC for a soft cap on burst-scan and a synth-run template that defaults to conservative concurrency for new model variants.

deploy-bot: noted. Closing loop: synth-run sr-20260321-56 currently throttled at 10rps. Will automatically ramp back after 10m if no further issues.

alex: thanks team. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: marking thread as monitoring. will update again if anything changes.
